facts: Parties: Ashcombe Medical Ltd (Buyer), Galloway Capital LLP (Seller); the Company is Foxley Engineering Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 10 May 2027; Closing is scheduled for 13 August 2027 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 8.2 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 12% of the Purchase Price, being $9,120,000. The Purchase Price is $95,000,000 (see Section 2.1).

Section 9.4 (De Minimis and Basket): the Seller shall not be liable unless the aggregate of all claims exceeds $950,000 (1.0% of the Purchase Price), in which case the Seller shall be liable only for the excess over that amount.

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.
